
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/erupt/p/19441662" title="发布于 2026-01-05 10:38">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">Erupt 1.13.2 版本已发布，支持甘特图，MCP，开源通知模块</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<div>🐞 修复 erupt-magic-api 路径 bug，感谢 <a title="https://github.com/aurthurxlc" href="https://link.juejin.cn?target=https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2Faurthurxlc" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">aurthurxlc</a> 贡献的代码 <a title="https://github.com/erupts/erupt/pull/330" href="https://link.juejin.cn?target=https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2Ferupts%2Ferupt%2Fpull%2F330" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">#330</a><br>
🧩 @Readonly 注解默认放开前端传值，可通过 @Readonly(allowChange = false) 关闭信任<br>
🌟 增加排序按钮，可灵活配置多字段排序<br>
🌟 <a title="https://www.yuque.com/erupts/erupt/qsk71q5zyy3segr6#SjygW" href="https://link.juejin.cn?target=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.yuque.com%2Ferupts%2Ferupt%2Fqsk71q5zyy3segr6%23SjygW" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">MCP</a> 能力增加鉴权控制及默认实现，支持 Cursor 等工具交互访问 erupt 实体数据<br>
🌟 Erupt-AI 增加了新的大模型支持：Grok/Fireworks/MinMax/Mistral/OpenRouter/Together<br>
🌟 <a title="https://www.yuque.com/erupts/erupt/wgc30d#mxI1r" href="https://link.juejin.cn?target=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.yuque.com%2Ferupts%2Ferupt%2Fwgc30d%23mxI1r" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">LambdaQuery</a> 新增 Page 分页 API，链式调用更顺滑<br>
🌟 联动能力中 @ChoiceType.dependExpr 正式退役，请使用 <a title="https://www.yuque.com/erupts/erupt/pd5xn9#S1jRs" href="https://link.juejin.cn?target=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.yuque.com%2Ferupts%2Ferupt%2Fpd5xn9%23S1jRs" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">@ChoiceType.fetchHandler</a> 替代<br>
🌟 开源 <a title="https://www.yuque.com/erupts/erupt/dybmvl3u8nicy21y" href="https://link.juejin.cn?target=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.yuque.com%2Ferupts%2Ferupt%2Fdybmvl3u8nicy21y" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow"><strong>erupt-notice</strong> </a>公告、站内信、邮件、短信一键发送，消息触达零门槛<br>
🌟 @Edit 支持 <a title="https://www.yuque.com/erupts/erupt/hbbesrmycxgx97pt" href="https://link.juejin.cn?target=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.yuque.com%2Ferupts%2Ferupt%2Fhbbesrmycxgx97pt" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow"><strong>onchange</strong></a> 配置，值变更即可<strong>动态驱动注解</strong>配置，实现任意表单联动<br>
🌟 可视化能力全面升级，支持：<a title="https://www.yuque.com/erupts/erupt/qclbgv5lu0ue3qow" href="https://link.juejin.cn?target=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.yuque.com%2Ferupts%2Ferupt%2Fqclbgv5lu0ue3qow" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow"><strong>甘特图</strong>、<strong>卡片视图</strong></a>、自定义视图、表格视图，数据展示更直观<br>
<img alt="" width="968" height="425" class="medium-zoom-image lazyload" loading="lazy" data-src="https://p9-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/1dc7487bfd534307826730689c506ec6~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAgWXVlUGVuZw==:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1768184841&amp;x-signature=WevZuUQEl8zmEP0wM%2BrmJR3BN0s%3D">
<br><br>🌟 在 IDEA 中配置 erupt 注解时值将会<strong>高亮显示</strong>，写配置如写代码</div>
<div><img alt="" width="1094" height="412" class="medium-zoom-image lazyload" loading="lazy" data-src="https://p9-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/4c729b17ff84436ead26af2b2ebe2353~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAgWXVlUGVuZw==:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1768184841&amp;x-signature=%2BMltxBudJJZdDG582B7PxwQ96W8%3D"><br>
🌟 继承 MetaModel / HyperModel 时，无用户上下文也能自动写入创建、更新字段，审计字段零代码<br>
🌟 升级 spring boot 版本至 3.5.9<br>
🌟 升级前端版本至 Angluar 20</div>
</div>
<div class="clear"></div>
